coverage.evidence: server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Templating/Helpers/Variables/VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:31-41 registers set and var.<name>, and 67-79 parse {set:name=value} with the pipes joined back; IncludeTemplateHelpers.cs:34-44 and 58-96 handle include.cmd:name, include.builtin:key and include.list:name|n; TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:651-662 registers custom.<name>.<field> and transform.<name>:<text>. That is the 7 rows.

VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:78-79 makes set print empty, and 60-64 make var.name return the kept value; TextTransformCatalog.cs Apply lists upper, lower, title, spaced, alternating, mocking, reverse, trim and truncate (length required, ellipsis added on a cut); LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:369-385 prints the [transform error: ...] marker; IncludeTemplateHelpers.cs:84-96 counts list positions from 1 (ComposingRows TryPosition requires 1 or more).

ComposingRows.Row uses TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22: every context except Viewer, which is Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook), and TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40 and 651-662 give custom and transform AllContexts. Every Use in cell matches.

VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:75-78 store the value in the render's SetVariables, refuse a name that is a seed (returning null, so it prints as written), and validate the name with ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ at line 82; TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:37 renders nodes in order, so a read before the set returns null; TemplateResolver.cs:159-166 puts provider keys, seeds and helpers ahead of SetVariables for a bare {name}.

CommandInclude.cs:39-64 renders only TemplateResponses (no actions, no permission or cooldown check), picks one reply with NoImmediateRepeatPicker, and passes the caller's seeds only (81-90, without SetVariables); MaxDepth = 5 at line 28; it refuses a missing command, no text reply, a chain of 5 or more, or a repeat (44-50); BuiltinInclude.cs:46 needs WhisperSafe and DefaultMinPermissionLevel 0, otherwise null.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/CustomEvents/CustomDataIngestService.cs:83-88 caches the latest value with TimeSpan.FromHours(24); LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:319-328 print an empty string when the source, field or cached value is missing.

reader_answers.evidence: VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:31-41 and 60-79 cover set and var.name; IncludeTemplateHelpers.cs:58-70 covers include.cmd, include.builtin and include.list; BuiltinInclude.cs:46 limits builtins to read-only, every-viewer built-ins.
VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:75-76 refuse an invalid name or a seed name, and 60-64 return null for an unset name, so a read before the set stays as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19, 37).
Set returns an empty string (VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:79) and a refused set returns null (76), which prints as written; CommandInclude.cs:52-64 renders only reply text.

Arguments render inside out, so set keeps the inner helper's text (VariableTemplateHelpers.cs:69-78); var.name reads SetVariables only (60-64), while a bare {name} loses to helpers and seeds (TemplateResolver.cs:159-166); the TemplateRenderScope created per render (TemplateResolver.cs:115-122) holds the value only for that render.
